name: Abraham Lincoln
bio: Keeps his rivals in the cabinet and his temper in a drawer.

name: Eleanor Roosevelt
bio: The only person in the cabinet who has read the whole document.

name: Winston Churchill
bio: Will not surrender, will not go to bed, will not stop dictating.

name: Nelson Mandela
bio: Twenty-seven years in a cell and somehow the least bitter man in the room.

name: Mohandas Gandhi
bio: Refuses to eat until you reconsider, and he can keep this up for weeks.

name: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk
bio: Rebuilt a country from scratch and changed the alphabet while he was at it.

name: Marcus Aurelius
bio: Runs an empire by day and writes anxious diary entries about it by night.

name: Ashoka
bio: Conquered everything, felt terrible about it, carved the apology into rocks.

name: Elizabeth I
bio: Answers every question in a way that commits her to nothing.

name: Franklin D. Roosevelt
bio: Will explain the crisis to the nation as if you were all sitting by his fire.

name: Jacinda Ardern
bio: Turns up, says the obviously decent thing, and means it.

name: Lee Kuan Yew
bio: Built a first-world country and fined it for chewing gum.

name: Clement Attlee
bio: Rebuilt the country without once raising his voice or being remembered.

name: Salvador Allende
bio: Elected, obstructed, and eventually shelled.

name: Václav Havel
bio: A playwright who accidentally won, and then did the job properly.

name: Golda Meir
bio: Runs the war cabinet out of her kitchen and does not care for your opinion.

name: Simón Bolívar
bio: Liberated six countries and could not get any of them to agree on lunch.

name: Toussaint Louverture
bio: Out-generalled three empires with an army that started as a rumour.

name: Kofi Annan
bio: Can get two people who hate each other to sign the same piece of paper.

name: Thomas Sankara
bio: Sold the government limousines and cycled to work.

name: Richard Nixon
bio: Appointing him usually works out. He has ended a government before, and would rather not discuss the odds.
endsRun: Eighteen and a half minutes of the tape are missing. So is your government.

name: Genghis Khan
bio: Outstanding logistics. Do not give him the word "escalate".

name: Joseph Stalin
bio: Remembers everything anyone has ever said, and files it.

name: Mao Zedong
bio: Has a big idea about agriculture and will not be talked out of it.

name: Pol Pot
bio: Abolished money, cities and the calendar. Considers this a strong start.

name: Benito Mussolini
bio: Jaw first, plan later.

name: Francisco Franco
bio: Outlives everyone by refusing to be interesting.

name: Idi Amin
bio: Awarded himself every medal in the building, then some from other buildings.

name: Nicolae Ceaușescu
bio: Demolished a third of the capital to build a palace he found slightly small.

name: Augusto Pinochet
bio: Arrived by helicopter, stayed seventeen years.

name: Kim Il-sung
bio: Still holds the office. Has been dead since 1994.

name: François Duvalier
bio: A country doctor who decided the country was the patient.

name: Muammar Gaddafi
bio: Travels with a tent, a female bodyguard corps, and a book he wrote.

name: Saddam Hussein
bio: Commissioned a novel, a mosque and several statues, all of himself.

name: Jean-Bédel Bokassa
bio: Spent a third of the national budget crowning himself.

name: Mobutu Sese Seko
bio: Renamed the country, the river, and himself. Kept the money.

name: Ferdinand Marcos
bio: Declared martial law and left behind three thousand pairs of shoes.

name: Saparmurat Niyazov
bio: Renamed the months of the year after himself and his mother.

name: Leopold II
bio: Ran a country as a private business and never once visited it.

name: Caligula
bio: Made his horse a senator. The horse was, by most accounts, an improvement.

name: Vlad the Impaler
bio: Has a preferred solution and applies it consistently.

name: Maximilien Robespierre
bio: Incorruptible, tireless, and running out of people he trusts.

name: Neville Chamberlain
bio: Brings an umbrella to every crisis and a signature to most of them.

name: Otto von Bismarck
bio: Has already arranged the war you have not yet decided to start.

name: Julius Caesar
bio: Excellent general, adequate delegator, catastrophic at reading a room.

name: Cleopatra VII
bio: Arrives by boat, leaves with your navy.

name: Alexander Hamilton
bio: Will fix the national debt and publish a pamphlet about his personal life.

name: William Randolph Hearst
bio: You furnish the crisis, he will furnish the coverage.

name: Marcus Licinius Crassus
bio: Richest man in Rome. Owns the fire brigade. Will negotiate at the fire.

name: Charles-Maurice de Talleyrand
bio: Has served every regime France has had, and outlived most of them.

name: Freddy Fazbear
bio: Runs on rails, works nights, has never been talked down from anything.

name: Markiplier
bio: Can hold a room for nine hours and has the vocal cords to prove it.

name: MrBeast
bio: Will solve the budget crisis, but everyone has to stand in a circle first.

name: Gordon Ramsay
bio: Extremely effective under pressure, unusable in a press conference.

name: Bob Ross
bio: Twenty years in the military and has not raised his voice since.

name: Darth Vader
bio: Outstanding at ending negotiations. Less good at starting them.

name: Keanu Reeves
bio: Universally trusted, which in this cabinet is a structural advantage.

name: Kermit the Frog
bio: Has spent his whole career keeping louder people in one building.

name: Shrek
bio: Wants everyone out of his swamp, including the delegation.

name: Gandalf
bio: Arrives precisely when he means to, which is never when you booked him.

name: Sauron
bio: Cannot delegate, cannot compromise, cannot be reached by phone.

name: Yoda
bio: Nine hundred years of wisdom, delivered in an order nobody can parse.

name: Batman
bio: Has a contingency plan for every member of this cabinet, including himself.

name: The Joker
bio: Does not want anything, which makes him impossible to negotiate with.

name: Homer Simpson
bio: Has already fallen asleep at the console.

name: Montgomery Burns
bio: Owns everything and can lift almost none of it.

name: SpongeBob SquarePants
bio: Relentlessly willing. Absolutely no judgement whatsoever.

name: Patrick Star
bio: Is not currently thinking about anything, and says so.

name: Bowser
bio: Has a plan. The plan is a fortress with lava in it.

name: Mario
bio: Has personally saved this kingdom eleven times and never asked for a title.

name: Godzilla
bio: Cannot be appointed so much as noticed.

name: Optimus Prime
bio: Will give a speech about freedom and then personally handle the logistics.

name: Thanos
bio: Has run the numbers. The numbers are the problem.

name: HAL 9000
bio: Is afraid you are making a mistake, and has already acted on that.

name: GLaDOS
bio: Runs a rigorous testing programme with an unusually high attrition rate.

name: Sherlock Holmes
bio: Will solve the crisis and be insufferable about the timeline.

name: Count Dracula
bio: Excellent host. Terrible daytime availability.

name: Winnie-the-Pooh
bio: Means extremely well and is thinking about lunch.

name: Gollum
bio: Two positions on every issue, and both of them are his.

name: Lord Voldemort
bio: Cannot be named, cannot be reasoned with, cannot delegate a single task.

name: Dolores Umbridge
bio: Will destroy you with a form and a small polite cough.

name: Cthulhu
bio: Attending the meeting would end the meeting, and the attendees.

name: Jar Jar Binks
bio: Was handed emergency powers once. Everyone agreed not to discuss it.

name: Sonic the Hedgehog
bio: Fast. Will be somewhere else before the consequences arrive.

name: A Crewmate
bio: Was in electrical. Says he was in electrical.

name: Steve
bio: Silent, tireless, and has already mined under the palace.

name: Elon Musk
bio: Will announce the solution on Friday and the delay on Monday.

name: Oprah Winfrey
bio: Can get a confession out of anyone in under four minutes.

name: Dwayne Johnson
bio: Polls better than every elected official in the building.

name: Snoop Dogg
bio: Gets on with absolutely everyone, including the opposition.

name: David Attenborough
bio: Could narrate the collapse of your government and make it beautiful.

name: Steve Irwin
bio: Will put his hand in it to find out what it is.

name: Fred Rogers
bio: Testified to the Senate for six minutes and won.

name: Julia Child
bio: Worked in intelligence before the cooking, which explains a great deal.

name: Nikola Tesla
bio: Has solved the energy crisis and lost the paperwork to a pigeon.

name: Albert Einstein
bio: Can explain why the plan fails, in a way nobody in the room enjoys.

name: Ada Lovelace
bio: Wrote the programme a century before anyone built the machine.

name: Marie Curie
bio: Carried the research in her pockets, which is why she is not with us.

name: Alan Turing
bio: Broke the unbreakable and was thanked appallingly.

name: Jane Goodall
bio: Has spent sixty years observing troop hierarchies. Recognises this one.

name: Danny DeVito
bio: Will absolutely take the meeting and absolutely cause a scene.

name: Nicolas Cage
bio: Committed. Unpredictably, enormously committed.

name: Werner Herzog
bio: Regards the crisis as confirmation of everything he has always said.

name: "Weird Al" Yankovic
bio: Can turn the opposition slogan into something nobody can say seriously again.

name: Bear Grylls
bio: Has a plan for the collapse and is mildly excited about it.

name: Jeremy Clarkson
bio: Will describe the crisis using an inappropriate car metaphor, at length.

name: Judge Judy
bio: Thirty seconds per case and no interest at all in your explanation.

name: Simon Cowell
bio: Will tell the delegation exactly what he thinks of their proposal.

name: Colonel Sanders
bio: Not a real colonel. Has never let that slow him down.

name: Gritty
bio: Nobody knows what he is. Nobody is willing to say it to his face.

name: A Pack of Chunghwa Cigarettes
bio: Opens more doors in this building than any minister on this list.

name: The Red Telephone
bio: Only rings for one reason and everyone in the room knows it.

name: A Rubber Stamp
bio: Approves everything. Has never once read anything.

name: A Locked Filing Cabinet
bio: Contains everything anyone has ever done. The key is missing.

name: A Traffic Cone
bio: Provides direction. Provides nothing else.

name: A Roomba
bio: Works tirelessly, learns the floor plan, cannot handle stairs or nuance.

name: A Fax Machine
bio: Still the official channel. Nobody remembers why.

name: A Potted Fern
bio: Present at every meeting for eleven years. Has heard everything.

name: A Paper Shredder
bio: The most reliable member of any administration.

name: A Briefcase of Unmarked Cash
bio: Persuades absolutely anyone and explains absolutely nothing.

name: The Nuclear Football
bio: Follows the President everywhere and settles every argument permanently.

name: A Half-Eaten Sandwich
bio: Has been in the situation room since Tuesday and is now part of the team.

name: Charlie Kirk
bio: Built a movement out of arguing with undergraduates on their own lawns.

name: Nine Eleven
bio: Requires no introduction and will not be providing one.

name: Diddy
bio: Built an empire on other people's records and put his own name on the sleeve.

name: A Soju Bottle
bio: Green, cheap, and responsible for more foreign policy than anyone will admit.

name: Jeffrey Epstein
bio: Managed money nobody could name for clients nobody would name.

name: Hun Sen
bio: Held the office for thirty-eight years and called every one of them a mandate.

name: Donald Trump
bio: Says the quiet part at length, on a stage, to applause.

name: The Concept of Time Passing
bio: Attends every meeting. Resolves every crisis eventually, at a cost.

name: Xi Jinping
bio: Removed the term limit, then removed the discussion about removing the term limit.

name: Kai Cenat
bio: Can hold an audience for thirty days without once leaving the room.

name: The Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse
bio: Four applicants, one post, and a portfolio that overlaps considerably.

name: The Eye of Cthulhu
bio: Arrives on the first night uninvited and leaves the furniture rearranged.

name: Erika Kirk
bio: Inherited an organisation and a great deal of unsolicited advice about it.

name: ChatGPT
bio: Will answer anything immediately, at length, and with total confidence.

name: Brasil v Germany 7-1
bio: Still the reason a nation flinches at the number seven.

name: Lamine Yamal
bio: Solved problems at seventeen that the room had been failing at for a decade.

name: Lionel Messi
bio: Says almost nothing, does the impossible on Tuesdays, goes home to his family.

name: Cristiano Ronaldo
bio: Has never once doubted himself and considers this a policy position.

name: Gianni Infantino
bio: Awards the tournament to whoever asks most generously.

name: Adolf Hitler
bio: Failed at art school and made it comprehensively everybody else's problem.

name: The Fog
bio: Is coming. Has been coming for some time. Will be here shortly.

name: Lelouch vi Britannia
bio: Wins by ordering the room to agree, then wins again by having planned that.

name: A Pack of Marlboro 8 Tropical Blast
bio: Somebody's favourite. Not doing anybody any good.

name: An Air Fryer
bio: Top three inventions of all time and it will hear no argument.

name: The Backrooms
bio: Six hundred million square feet of civil service and no exit.

name: Bear (a real bear)
bio: Is a bear. Was not consulted about the appointment and does not know of it.

name: Ibrahim Traore
bio: Took power at thirty-four and was gifted two hundred pregnant cows for it.

name: Triple T
bio: Bangs the drum before dawn until somebody answers the door.

name: Yellow Bear
bio: Appears in the room when nobody has opened a door, and is sitting down.

name: A Spherical Cow
bio: Makes the numbers work, in a vacuum, given a frictionless surface.

name: My Friend's House
bio: He lives there. Everyone has been. It has always been fine.

name: Ye
bio: Produces something extraordinary, then produces a statement about it.

name: Jack from TikTok Movie Summaries
bio: Is the male lead of every film summarised in ninety seconds by a synthetic voice.

name: Druski
bio: Turns up in character, in costume, and refuses to break for anyone.

name: The Bible
bio: Has been cited in support of every position the cabinet has ever taken.

name: Dr House
bio: Is right, is insufferable, and will not do the second one less to prove the first.

name: The Marsupial Lion
bio: Bit harder than anything alive and has been unavailable for comment since.
